name: Planetiny
detailed_description:
PLANETINY: A TINY GARDEN OF GALAXIES 🌌✨

Discover your own cosmic nook, focus or relax whenever you need.

Planetiny is a relaxing idle game where you can discover galaxies, gather adorable creatures called Tinies, and create your own cosmic collection. There's no rush or urgent goals, just you, space, and your Tinies, in a universe designed for your peace of mind.

ALWAYS WITH YOU, ALWAYS CALM 🪐🖥️

Desktop Mode: your ideal companion for working, studying, or relaxing.

Activate Desktop Mode and let your universe keep you company while you do other things. The game fits into a cozy corner of your screen, always visible, creating the perfect atmosphere for focus or relaxation.

A SPACE THAT SOUNDS JUST THE WAY YOU LIKE 🎶🌙

Customize the sound atmosphere and enjoy it your way.

In Planetiny, you can adjust the audio experience to your liking. Combine different layers of ambient effects, choose your favorite musical style between Chill and LoFi modes, and select the right binaural sound for each moment. This way, you'll always have the perfect background to relax or concentrate.

COLLECT RACES, DISCOVER RARITIES 💛🌱

18 Tiny races, 4 rarities per race, and a huge visual collection.

Discover new galaxies, planets, and Tinies. Each race has its own charm, with different colors, styles, and accessories. Expand your collection, rename them, and enjoy the little details that make every Tiny unique, with no rush and always at your own pace.

BRING YOUR PLANETS TO LIFE 🌍🍃

Boost your production and see how each planet evolves.

The more Tinies you gather, the more resources you'll generate. Feed your Tinies to discover their preferences and gain a productivity boost. Upgrade your planets and watch how the environment changes with new visual elements inspired by each race, inviting you to imagine their stories and customs.

No rush, no pressure. Just you, space, and your Tinies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dedicated GPU with 3GB of free VRAM required
